title: AISE Identity Protocol Schema
description: Defines how a project declares its identity to any AISE-compliant agent.

version.description: AISE Protocol version this project follows. Example: '1.0'.

project_id.description: Project unique identifier. UUID or repository identity.

version.description: Project version (SemVer, frozen, or project-defined format). Decoupled from AISE Protocol version and Governance Runtime version.

runtime.description: Governance Runtime version, e.g. '2.5.0frozen'. Used by aise-verify to check runtime compatibility.
